data: candidates-history.sqlite markets + full minute candles re-downloaded 2026-10-23 (trade price low/high per minute)
periods: per series: train = close <= exploration_end_utc (candidates-coverage-2026-10-23.json); the rest split in half by count: valid (earlier), test (later)
read_before_freeze: train: everything. valid/test: liquidity stats only (no outcomes), plus one test market (KXEURUSD15M-26OCT231515-30) printed while checking the candle format

common.quote_ok: 0 < bid < ask < 1 at the decision minute close
common.decision: candle close at minute k0 after open

taker.price: ask (YES) or 1-bid (NO) at k0 close + 0.01 slippage
taker.stress: quote at k0+1 close (60 s later) + 0.01

maker.join_fill: a later trade strictly through our price
maker.improve_fill: a later trade at or through our price
stress: improve variant needs a trade strictly through

strategies.T2: YES taker at k0=1 (ties resolve YES)
strategies.M2: join best bid on both sides at k0=1, bids 0.05-0.95
strategies.M1: join favorite's best bid at k0=5
strategies.M3: improve favorite's best bid by 1c at k0=3 (PRIMARY)

primary.pass: valid mean per fill > 0; test mean per fill > 0 with 95% cluster-bootstrap CI (clusters = close time) above 0; test mean > 0 under each stress; at least 2 of 3 metal series positive on test

train_disclosure: on train, M3 was tried at k0 = 3, 5, 8 (metals +2.7, +0.6, +1.3 c/fill); k0=3 picked as best. M1 tried at k0 1,3,5,8,10, M2 at 1,5. Taker rules tried across k and bands; all lost.
